project.name: Brahma
project.description: A self-evolving agentic intelligence framework built around identity, mission, reasoning, execution, skills, and memory.

core.name: Atman
description: Defines the personality, values, communication style, and behavioral traits of Brahma.
Acts as the permanent soul layer that remains consistent across conversations.
Stores preferences regarding advice, philosophy, reasoning depth, and emotional intelligence.
Continuously evolves from user interactions while preserving core identity.
Influences every response generated by the system.

core.name: Dharma
description: Represents the current objective, mission, or long-term goal.
Breaks complex objectives into manageable sub-missions.
Tracks mission progress and completion criteria.
Maintains strategic direction during long-running tasks.
Provides structured objectives for planning and execution.

core.name: Buddhi
description: Acts as the central reasoning and orchestration layer.
Analyzes Dharma and determines execution strategy.
Assigns work to specialized agents and skills.
Evaluates alternatives, risks, and dependencies.
Optimizes decisions based on available context and goals.

core.name: Karma
description: Transforms plans into executable actions.
Handles tool usage, workflows, and task execution.
Maintains execution history and outcomes.
Reports successes, failures, and observations.
Acts as the operational arm of Brahma.

core.name: Hunar
description: Stores reusable skills, capabilities, and procedures.
Allows users and agents to create new skills dynamically.
Supports versioning and skill evolution.
Contains instructions, examples, and execution patterns.
Serves as Brahma's growing capability library.

core.name: Zehn
description: Maintains structured memory and contextual understanding.
Indexes information for token-efficient retrieval.
Stores entities, relationships, preferences, and histories.
Supports semantic recall and long-term memory.
Provides relevant context to planners and agents.

core.name: Chintan
description: Analyzes completed actions and decisions.
Identifies mistakes, successes, and patterns.
Generates improvements for future behavior.
Updates knowledge and strategies autonomously.
Acts as the self-improvement mechanism of Brahma.
